entries.effect: the 11 field kinds, their properties, region, items and the 32-field limit as 9.0's, built over the public 7.0 UIDynamicBehavior, UIPushBehavior and UIDynamicItemBehavior; the force of every kind is 9.0's, but it is applied once per animator step after the world step, a one-step lag where 9.0 applies it per Box2D sub-step: 0.09 to 2.1 pt from 9.0's own field over 60 frames (electric and magnetic act on a charge, which the release below 7.0 lacks); collisionBoundsType Ellipse and Path are not carried below 7.0 (deferred: the port's own animator can build a circle and a fan of convex pieces) and are not expressible on 7.0-8.x, over Apple's collision behavior; the item keeps its rectangle
